placements.title: Formal expungement of legacy architectural decisions and migration records from active institutional memory
placements.frame: How does the organization formally decommission and expunge legacy architectural decisions and database migration records from institutional knowledge?
placements.why: The input explicitly mandates the removal and intentional forgetting of legacy architectural artifacts (the Quantum Widget Decision and PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration), establishing a theme of deliberate institutional knowledge expungement.

mints.name: KnowledgeGovernance
mints.title: Architectural decision lifecycle management and explicit knowledge governance policies
mints.why: Captures organizational thinking and policy surrounding the retention, deprecation, and expungement of architectural and technical records.
